effects.effect:
You gain a domain feature from your domain, as shown on the 1st-Level [Censor](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/censor) Domain Features table. Additionally, you gain a skill from your domain, chosen from the skill group indicated on the table.

###### 1st-Level Censor Domain Features Table

| Domain                           | Feature                       | Skill Group   |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------------|---------------|
| Creation                         | [Hands of the Maker](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.censor.level-1/hands-of-the-maker)            | Crafting      |
| Death                            | [Grave Speech](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.censor.level-1/grave-speech)                  | Lore          |
| Fate                             | [Oracular Visions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/oracular-visions)              | Lore          |
| Knowledge                        | [Blessing of Comprehension](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/blessing-of-comprehension)     | Lore          |
| Life                             | [Revitalizing Ritual](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/revitalizing-ritual)           | Exploration   |
| Love                             | [Blessing of Compassion](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/blessing-of-compassion)        | Interpersonal |
| Nature                           | [Faithful Friend](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.censor.level-1/faithful-friend)               | Exploration   |
| Protection                       | [Protective Circle](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/protective-circle)             | Exploration   |
| Storm                            | [Blessing of Fortunate Weather](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/blessing-of-fortunate-weather) | Exploration   |
| Sun                              | [Inner Light](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/inner-light)                   | Lore          |
| Trickery                         | [Inspired Deception](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/inspired-deception)            | Intrigue      |
| War                              | [Sanctified Weapon](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/sanctified-weapon)             | Exploration   |
